# InsureRecon

InsureRecon is a browser-based Workers' Comp audit evidence reconciliation tool for U.S. construction contractors and subcontractor-heavy businesses.

## What it does
- Imports payment/AP records.
- Reads Workers' Comp, self-insurance, exemption and related evidence from CSV/XLSX/PDF/images.
- Matches payments to vendor evidence and coverage dates.
- Flags missing evidence, wrong evidence type, coverage gaps, outside-period records and uncertain document dates.
- Produces an evidence map, review list, evidence request list and audit-preparation report.
- Keeps uncertain cases in MANUAL REVIEW rather than auto-confirming them.

## What it does not do
- It is not legal advice.
- It does not determine legal coverage, contractor status, payroll classification or final premium.
- It is not continuous carrier verification and is not a generic COI expiration tracker.

## Trial
https://yfhu17776-cyber.github.io/audit-ready/

## Pricing
7.70 USDT/month is the planned self-serve price. Live payment receiving details are not configured until the product's utility is validated.
